description.fun: People of ancient times believed Larvesta fell from the sun, and they called it the Larva That Stole the Sun. It lives at the foot of volcanoes and spouts fire from its five horns, hot enough to cut through a sheet of iron, to scare off predators. It was worshipped as an emissary of the sun, but also seen as a burden for starting forest fires. When it evolves, it wraps itself in a cocoon of flames.
description.guide: Larvesta is a Bug- and Fire-type larva Pokémon that shoots fire from its five horns and lives near volcanoes. It encases itself in a cocoon of fire to evolve into Volcarona.
description.tagline: A fuzzy larva once believed to have fallen from the sun.

description.fun: Volcarona hatches from a cocoon of raging flames, and legend says it appeared in a bitterly cold winter to save people and Pokémon from freezing; when volcanic ash darkened the sky, its fire is said to have stood in for the sun. Ancient people both feared it as the rage of the sun and worshipped it as a deity of fire. It's revered in cold lands but unpopular in hot ones, and its burning scales rob the air of oxygen.
description.guide: Volcarona is the evolved form of Larvesta, a Bug- and Fire-type moth Pokémon that scatters burning scales from its six wings. It has long been revered as an embodiment of the sun.
description.tagline: A blazing moth once worshipped as a stand-in for the sun.
